fact_sources.fact: Samsung raised Galaxy A prices in India from Mon 16 Nov 2026; A57 8GB+256GB ₹62,999 -> ₹66,999, 12GB+256GB ₹72,499 -> ₹76,499
A57 8+256 was ₹59,999 after the August hike and ₹62,999 from 6 Sep (third rise since August = Aug, Sep, Nov)
Other Galaxy A models +₹2,000 per variant; base prices A07 ₹22,999, A17 ₹29,999, A36 ₹38,999, A56 ₹46,999, A37 ₹48,999
Galaxy F17 and F70e also up ₹2,000
